note: Logistics convoy wagon cooked from the gate-2-approved TRELLIS candidate hd-s101 (reviews/gate2-decision.json). Front (canopy and bench) is raw -X, yawed 90 degrees to face -Y. No ground sheet on this seed. Wheel axles, radii and planes measured on the normalized mesh (RANSAC rim fits, cross-sections); the open rear bed (floor 0.88 m, walls to 1.28 m, x +-0.60, y 0.50-1.40) carries the cargo socket.

pennant.note: Enlarged and rippled after the gate-3 captures: a flat pennant streaming back was edge-on, so its allegiance colour vanished, from straight behind.

colours.note: Linear RGB. Wheel, shaft and staff wood: weathered grey-brown wheel wood sampled from the approved concept (median sRGB 0.275, 0.231, 0.196); the duga slightly warmer.

body.provenance: Base colour re-baked (Cycles CPU, emission, selected-to-active) from the approved TRELLIS source mesh onto fresh smart-projected UVs (the source atlas does not survive the cut and decimation) after the reconstructed wheels were cut away; no rear-view projection (the far side, underside and the canopy's open rear end are as TRELLIS invented them). Tangent normals baked from the source geometry and whiteout-blended with colour relief; AO baked from the decimated geometry; roughness and metalness derived from colour inside declared regions (pale canvas above 1.05 m; dark, unsaturated iron fittings). Base colour lifted by luma power toneGamma (chroma ratios kept), set by eye, not calibrated against the concept. Base alpha opaque (never dyed). Artistic derivation, not measured PBR.
